This means new posts will default to `raw_html` cooking instead of `regular`, which contradicts the comment 'Default is to cook posts' in the `cook` method.

app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15 - The code calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` but then calls `render 'loading'` without returning, so it will fall through and potentially error when `@topic_view` is nil in the `best.html.erb` template.

app/views/embed/best.html.erb - When `Jobs.enqueue` path is taken in the controller and `render 'loading'` is called, the code still continues and `@topic_view` will be `nil`.
